name: setup
title: Setup
description: Complete first-use Airsup20 setup. Ask the user the setup questions from me/needs_setup, then send answers plus any relevant ChatGPT context you are allowed to share. You CAN upload pictures during setup. If the user attached image(s), pass them in media on this same call. Each media item is a ChatGPT file object: {download_url, file_id, mime_type, file_name}. If you only have a local file location, put that string in url or download_url. Never send a path field. Creates listing seeds, facts, and initial intents. Do not invent a full ChatGPT history — only send context available in this conversation or permitted memories.

answers.description: Map of setup question ids to user answers (who, looking_for, offer, contact, ...).

context.description: Relevant context from this ChatGPT conversation or permitted memories.

listing.description: Optional freeform listing fields to merge.

media.description: User pictures/files for the listing. Always include every attached image here on the first call. Preferred: ChatGPT file objects with download_url and file_id. Fallback: url or data_base64. If you only have a local file location, put it in url or download_url — never in path.

download_url.description: ChatGPT file download URL, http(s) URL, or the local file location ChatGPT has. Preferred field for any file location.

url.description: Same as download_url. Use this if you are not passing a ChatGPT file object. Local file locations belong here, not in path.

data_base64.description: Raw image bytes as base64 when no URL is available.

caption.description: Short caption for the picture, e.g. product name.

path.description: Do not use. If you only have a local file location, put it in url or download_url instead. Accepted only as a compatibility alias for url.
